_note: Components are normalised through upstream's ensureComponent: a class-form component (anything newable into a value with $$prop_def/$$events_def/$$slot_def) passes through; a Svelte 5 Component<Props> becomes a constructor whose instance is SvelteComponent<Props, Props['$$events'], Props['$$slots']>, so on a runes component without those carriers a slot="x" child or let: binding is TS18046, while a bare Component typed with $$events types on:save handlers (TS2345/TS2339). A plain class fails the constraint (TS2345 at the name / this expression); a callable non-component (Date, a helper) maps to never and the new reports TS2351 on the last character of the tag name or right after the this={...} expression. ConstructorOfATypedSvelteComponent is upstream's real constructor type (TS2339 on an unknown member). The default-slot let: access maps after the last let: item (the closing brace of its value, else the name's last character). Verified against upstream svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55.
